title: Auth helper with three issues

findings.description: `unusedFlag` is assigned but never read. Remove it to keep the function focused.
Username and password are interpolated into SQL, enabling injection and leaking credentials into query logs. Use parameterized queries and never pass raw passwords into SQL strings.

after: "SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ? AND password_hash = ?",

findings.description: The loop condition `i <= scores.length` reads one element past the end of the array.
